note: Adapted from the original description of Silvestri 1914 (Latin), published as Eutermes tenebricus sp. n. (placed in Fulleritermes in the catalogue of Snyder 1949); the queen, nymph, soldier, large and small workers and measurements are given. The original uses the comma as decimal separator, transcribed here as 4.2, 1.57 and so on; the printed hind tibia length of the soldier is incomplete in the scan ("1.") and is not given.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Nearest to Eutermes coarctatus, but the soldier has 13-segmented antennae, by which it can be distinguished; the soldier head is about twice as long as wide and the nasus rather narrow, the outer basal process of the mandible very short and tubercle-like.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier: body chestnut to red chestnut, the middle part of the head brick red or yellow rusty, the nasus blackish. Head about twice as long as wide, constricted at the antennal insertions, the nasus rather narrow; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 one third or a little more longer than segment 2, segment 4 nearly as long as segment 2, segment 5 slightly longer than segment 4; outer basal process of the mandible very short, tubercle-like. Anterior lobe of the pronotum very short, the anterior margin broadly rounded. Legs long. Abdominal tergites with few and very short hairs (especially the distal ones), the sternites with a few short hairs and shorter hairs, and several considerably long apical hairs. Measurements: body length 4.2 mm; head length 1.57 mm; head width 0.80 mm; nasus length 0.78 mm; antenna length 1.69 mm (the printed hind tibia length is incomplete in the scan).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: body chestnut or red chestnut, the cephalic sutures pale ochreous white. Cephalic fontanelle window similar to that of the alate but smaller, the clypeus slightly inflated; antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2 and one third longer than segment 4, segment 5 slightly longer than segment 4. Anterior lobe of the pronotum rather large, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Measurements: body length 4 mm; head length 0.92 mm; head width 0.95 mm; antenna length 1.56 mm; hind tibia length 1.10 mm. Small worker: body length 3.7 mm; head width 0.85 mm; antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 nearly as long as segment 4 or slightly shorter than it, segment 4 shorter.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen: black, clypeus chestnut, fontanelle window milky white, sternites blackish chestnut, intersegmental membrane dirty milky white; cephalic fontanelle window narrow and long, forked at the anterior end, clypeus twice as wide as long, eyes rather small and slightly protruding, ocelli small, farther from the eye than the ocellar long diameter; pronotum only slightly wider than the head (with the eyes), distinctly concave in the middle of the posterior margin. Measurements: body length 15 mm; abdomen width 3 mm; head length 0.94 mm, width 0.88 mm; long diameter of the eye 0.28 mm; hind tibia length 1.5 mm. Nymph: body length 6 mm, head width 0.86 mm, wing pads 0.75 mm long, antennae 14-segmented. Localities and nests: Kakoulima (type locality) and Kindia, French Guinea; Olokemeji, southern Nigeria; small nests built on the ground, about 10 cm high or a little more, 15—20 cm in basal diameter, partly built under or against stones, the cells and galleries among the roots of herbaceous plants.
